findings.text: non-blocking: `review_run_record_names` re-implements the per-reviewed-run name grouping the module already owns. `_index_maps` (reckon/crew/review_records.py:1516) builds `reviewed: dict[run_id, list[entry]]` with each entry's `name`, `_document_index_maps` (line 2560) caches it per document generation and version, and `_store_index` (line 1903) exposes it; `_misfiled_review_candidates` (reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:415) already answers this exact question through it, at a cost bounded by that run's records. The landed change instead adds a second, persisted grouping, `run_names`, carrying every record name again inside an index document that plan sections 61 and 62 already name as the station's memory pressure, and that three writers must keep in step with `entries`. It duplicates the capability rather than extending its owner.

non-blocking: the incremental maintenance of `run_names` is covered by no test in this diff. `tests/test_a_pointer_reads_only_its_runs_records.py` writes its records directly to disk and then indexes them through `store_index_document`, so only `_rebuild_index_document` (reckon/crew/review_records.py:2238) is exercised. A regression in `_move_run_name` at line 2339 in `_index_stored_record` or line 2455 in `reconcile_foreign_write`, or in `_drop_run_name` at line 2466, would leave `run_names` naming a removed record or missing a rewritten one while every assertion in the case still passes, because the case never writes or removes a record after indexing.

non-blocking: the manifest records the two arms as `all_debug job 1317161 (base)` and `1317164 (after)` in its tests and evidence_inputs lines, while the logs it cites carry different job ids in their own header lines: logs/suite-base.log and logs/negative-control-base.log read `job: 1317265` and `job: 1317273`, and logs/suite-after.log reads `job: 1317268`. The logs are complete and self-consistent, but the manifest's provenance line names jobs that appear in no log it cites, so a reader cannot reconcile the receipt against the report without noticing the contradiction.
